title: Post-release 502 Bad Gateway storm on Checkout
root_cause: Regression introduced in validation middleware requiring backward incompatible schema fields
resolution: Rollback deployment to previous stable release tag and patched validator

title: Postgres connection pool saturation on Orders Service
root_cause: Long-running reporting query holding unindexed table locks, starving HikariCP connection pool
resolution: Terminated idle and long-running reporting backend connections, scaled connection pool maximum to 150

title: JVM Heap exhaustion from catalog cache pre-load
root_cause: Unbounded cache insertion during seasonal catalog preload without eviction policy
resolution: Restarted service with cache eviction policy and configured soft memory ceiling

title: Downstream email provider TCP RST loop causing worker stall
root_cause: Email provider MTU mismatch causing dropped packets and TCP RST bursts across peering connection
resolution: Enabled secondary circuit breaker route to backup SES SMTP endpoint

title: Consul KV synchronization error resetting JWT TTL to zero
root_cause: Automation script pushed default 0 integer for TOKEN_EXPIRY_SECONDS
resolution: Reverted Consul KV to 3600 seconds and hot-reloaded configuration
